items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I'll tell you one of the biggest openings they ever had, that was Pearl Bailey. Of course, she always had a band too, you know.

ctx.x: Friday morning. That's the opening day. Friday morning to Thursday night. And oh, the hustle and bustle, and guys getting in, you know, to get a seat. Guy want to hear Johnny Hodges' new solo that he played on "Mood Indigo," or whatever in the hell it was. Everybody was there for Duke's opening 'cause they were so delicate, so rare, so fabulous, you know. They'd have all these lights and, you know, they were dressed, you know what I mean, to the last point and...although other bands, like Lionel Hampton... Lionel…

I'll tell you one of the biggest openings they ever had, that was Pearl Bailey. Of course, she always had a band too, you know. But she had a variety show...singers and comedians. They'd have always...the format would be with John Mason, who was a comedian, he was usually hired by the theater... they did a bit...they called it a "bit." and this bit would consist of some comedy, where the guy would...the comedian would get up his wife and fix his breakfast and he would go to work and then Sweet Papa Charlie would…
